release_notes:
1. All 3 Strategy Options Exposed With Individual Hover Cards: Every catalog strategy (Composite ID, Base Product ID, Reference/SKU) is now simultaneously displayed with its own dedicated info icon and hover tooltip.
2. Interactive Selection: Clicking any strategy card automatically selects it in the dropdown and highlights the active choice with an active badge and checkmark.
3. Two-Way Sync: Changing the dropdown automatically syncs and updates the cards.
